messages:
Maria-SE: Quick sync — Helios POC timeline check. Customer wants dry-run week of May 6. Need owners + blockers.
Alex-Infra: I can own networking/VPC peering + firewall rules. ETA to get test subnet ready ~ 48h after we get IP ranges from Helios.
Priya-PM: Helios will share IPs on Monday. Success criteria: 1) API connectivity 2) SSO + SCIM 3) End-to-end inference with sample dataset.
Jordan-SolEng: I'll lead the SE integration for model calls, + validate token handling. Need clarify on embedding latency SLO — customer asked < 300ms median.
Sam-Eng: For the model endpoint, do we want Dedicated slice or Hosted? Dedicated might simplify throughput but adds infra setup.
Maria-SE: Helios prefers Dedicated for predictability. Can we provision a small Dedicated pool for the dry-run? @Alex-Infra @Sam-Eng
Alex-Infra: Yes, we can spin a small Dedicated instance in us-west-2. Need a ticket for resource approval -> I'll queue with infra.
Katie-CS: I'll coordinate customer windows. They requested a dry-run on Tue/Thu mornings. We should aim for Tue May 7 as first dry-run.
Sam-Eng: Blocker: SCIM SSO needs idp metadata from Helios and a test account. If we get that by Mon, we can complete SSO setup Mon-Tue.
Priya-PM: I'll chase Helios for metadata + test accounts today.
Jordan-SolEng: Integration deliverables list: 1) API contract (paths + auth) 2) Test prompts set (10 canonical prompts) 3) Latency/end-to-end perf doc 4) Rollback plan. I'll draft the API contract today.
Maria-SE: Thanks. Can folks drop one-line readiness updates here by EOD Friday? We'll then lock the dry-run date. :thumbsup:
Alex-Infra: Ready to provision once IPs + approval in ticket.
Sam-Eng: SCIM blocking until metadata; otherwise endpoint ready.
Jordan-SolEng: Draft API contract posted to the doc: https://redwood.example.com/helios/poc-contract (will ping when up).
Katie-CS: Customer contacted, asked for a smoke test checklist — I'll compile from Jordan's deliverables.
deploy-bot: Deployment job #4782 queued for dedicated-slice-provision (waiting on infra-approval).
Maria-SE: Nice. If no major issues, plan: Mon-May-6 provision infra, Tue-May-7 dry-run morning, Thu-May-9 follow-up. Any objections?
Priya-PM: No objections. I'll update the project tracker and assign owners.
Alex-Infra: Filed infra ticket INF-2127 and requested approval.
Sam-Eng: I'll put SCIM task on my board and ping again once metadata arrives.
Maria-SE: Great — quick CTA: everyone please drop any hard blockers now. Otherwise we mark this thread as the single source for readiness pings.
Jordan-SolEng: Blocking: need confirmation on token rotation policy from security — @Priya-PM can you flag?
Priya-PM: Flagged to security; will escalate if no response by EOD.
Katie-CS: I'll send calendar invites for the proposed dry-run slots once infra confirms.
Maria-SE: Awesome. Thanks all.
